quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Back on track: Multiple units in Brazil are entering a new (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rail order (release): Rolls-Royce is supplying mtu PowerPacks for a rail vehicle project in Latin America for the first time: Marcopolo Rail is installing six mtu PowerPacks of the 6H1800R83 type in three diesel multiple units for the urban rail network of Teresina, Brazil (operated by CFLP); the first six have been delivered and the first train will be in assisted operation service from October 2026. A further six mtu PowerPacks are due to be delivered by the end of 2026 for three light multiple units for the Arapiraca suburban rail project in Brazil.
quarterly_data.figure: six PowerPacks delivered; a further six by the end of 2026
